_meta.description: One entry per catalogue variant slot. Maps prices.variantsJson and SQLite history variant keys onto each slot. Not used at runtime yet.

cards.<cardId>.<catalogueVariant>.priceSheetVariant: string | null — key inside prices.variantsJson; null = manual price only or no API price
cards.<cardId>.<catalogueVariant>.sqliteVariants: string[] — price_history variant values to read for this slot; empty = use catalogue variant as-is
cards.<cardId>.<catalogueVariant>.note: string (optional) — hints when legacy data was parked on the first variant pending manual move

_meta.notes: Every catalogue slot is listed. priceSheetVariant uses the normalized key stored in prices.variantsJson (normal, holo, reverse, or firstEdition), or null for manual-only/no API pricing. sqliteVariants contains only legacy price-history aliases; empty means use the catalogue variant key as-is.

unresolvedCardIds.description: Legacy references whose base cardId no longer exists in data/cards.json.
